securityScan.noLeaksTitle: No intelligence leaks detected in known databases.
securityScan.noLeaksBody: Cross-referenced {count} identifier(s) against known public breaches and dark web paste dumps. The target's digital footprint remains uncompromised.

chatInput.placeholderSearch: Enter name or username (use '/' to separate)...
chatInput.errorTimeout: The search took too long to complete. Try reducing the search depth or searching a less common name.
chatInput.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the analysis server. Please verify that the backend and Ollama are running.
chatInput.errorServer: The analysis server failed while building the report.
chatInput.errorUnknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
chatInput.placeholderAwaitingAnswer: Answer the question above to continue the search…
chatInput.fallbackNotice: Interactive discovery is disabled on this backend (HTTP 503), so the classic one-shot search ran instead. It cannot pause to ask you clarifying questions — set DISCOVERY_ENABLED=true on the server to get them.
chatInput.sessionDone: Interactive search finished: {rounds} round(s), {evidence} evidence item(s), {profiles} profile(s). The live panel above holds the full breakdown.
chatInput.sessionCancelled: Search cancelled. Whatever was found before the stop is still shown above.

memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: Store facts and preferences JARVIS remembers across sessions.

watch.title: Watch

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.desc: Enable and run custom intelligence extensions.

system.title: System Actions

progress.heading: Discovery in progress
progress.waitingForYou: Stopped — the search is waiting for your answer above. Nothing advances until you reply or the timer runs out.

platforms.heading: Platform coverage
platforms.legendTitle: Blocked is not the same as not found
platforms.legendBody: “Blocked” means the platform refused us, so we still do not know. “Not found” means we looked and there is no such account.

meaning.not_found: We checked {platform} and there is no such account.
meaning.blocked: {platform} refused the check. Whether an account exists is still unknown.
meaning.error: The check on {platform} failed before reaching a verdict.

question.heading: The search is paused and needs your answer
question.subheading: Nothing continues until you reply or the timer runs out.
question.expired: Time is up — the search continued without an answer.
question.closed: That question already closed — the search has moved on.
question.noPenalty: “I don’t know” costs nothing: it adds no evidence and takes none away.

alternates.heading: Different people who share this name
alternates.body: These are NOT part of the profile above. They are namesakes we found and deliberately kept separate.

claims.heading: Biography
claims.empty: No statement could be backed by evidence.

notices.heading: Caveats
notices.questionTimeout: A question timed out and was treated as “I don’t know”.
